article.story:
Aston Villa's winless run extended to seven matches after Ipswich produced a spirited second-half display to fight back for an entertaining 2-2 draw at Portman Road.

Villa deservedly went in front twice through Alysson and João Gomes during a one-sided first half, but Emersonn's smart close-range finish provided a lifeline for hosts Town.

After boos greeted the halftime whistle, Ipswich emerged fired up for the second half and Gary O'Neil's men secured a potentially precious point through Leif Davis' 56th-minute header, although they have failed to win any of their last six Premier League fixtures.
